## Technical Specializations & Key Systems

### 1. AI Engineering & LLM Systems
- **Specialization:** Zero-hallucination grounded RAG architectures, centralized choke-point LLM gateways, vector databases, and real-time multimodal agents.
- **Key Architectures:**
  - *Centralized Choke-Point LLM Gateway:* Token-bucket rate limiter enforcing strict RPM, TPM, and TPD boundaries with an Earliest Deadline First (EDF) scheduler and an L0-L4 adaptive degradation ladder.
  - *Grounded RAG Pipeline:* Citation verification protocol with mathematical entailment verification over academic ML papers (Attention Is All You Need, Moshi, Dynamic Chunking), guaranteeing 100% citation coverage or truthful refusal.
  - *Kira AI Agent:* Multimodal autonomous desktop agent built on Gemini Live API over WebSockets, OpenCV screen perception, and a cyberpunk PyQt6 HUD.

### 2. Machine Learning Engineering
- **Specialization:** Deep learning search ranking models, representation learning, feature engineering, and MLOps.
- **Experience:** Machine Learning Intern at FlyRank (July 2026 - Sept 2026).
  - Trained Random Forest and Transformer ranking models predicting search engine rank positions from multi-dimensional content and structural signals.
  - Achieved 84% Precision@50 and 91% Top-20 Precision on 30,000+ search-log rows (up to 3.5x lift over 24% rule-based baseline).
  - Maintained 0.00% target leakage through strict data contracts and GroupKFold cross-validation; authored a 38-page technical report.

### 3. Full-Stack Software Development
- **Specialization:** High-performance web applications, scalable APIs, and browser automation tools.
- **Tech Stack:** React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Tailwind CSS, Capacitor.
- **Key Systems:**
  - *CP-Vault:* Manifest V3 Chrome Extension syncing solutions from LeetCode, Codeforces, CodeChef, and HackerRank directly to GitHub with SHA-256 deduplication and offline queueing.
  - *Campus Buddy:* Mobile-first peer-to-peer student marketplace with authenticated university domains, real-time messaging, and sub-50ms database queries.
  - *Gradastra:* Zero-commission higher education intelligence platform with unbiased senior student mentorship.

### 4. Quantitative Finance
- **Specialization:** Algorithmic trading backtests, statistical modeling, and financial time-series forecasting.
- **Background:** Quantitative Trainee with D+A Strategies (2026 cohort); backtesting statistical arbitrage and volatility-breakout models with risk budgeting (Sharpe, Sortino, Maximum Drawdown).
